'''Rebel Leader Packs''' is the 4th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in April 1996. It is a two-card Light Side premium: [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]] and [[Red Leader In Red 1]]. Mail-in offer from April 1996 through 31 January 1998.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
